final: WITH g AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) <> '' GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS mean_all FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.pattern, g.avg_igg, g.avg_igg - m.mean_all AS above_mean FROM g, m WHERE g.avg_igg > m.mean_all) SELECT pattern, avg_igg, above_mean, avg_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) FROM k) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM k ORDER BY avg_igg DESC
